Potential_Failure_Cause: High audio burst at low VBUS (4.5V); excessive peak current (>3.6A)
Local_Effect: Inductor core saturation; switch current runaway; MP3426 enters overcurrent latch
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Bassinet stops soothing abruptly; high audible squeal/whine
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Upgrade L1 to SWPA8040S (Isat=5.0A). 2. Firmware volume clamped to -3.5dBFS (0x37). 3. VBUS brownout monitoring.

Potential_Failure_Cause: 0603 MLCC ferroelectric degradation at 12V DC bias (-75% capacitance loss)
Local_Effect: Output voltage ripple increases from 12mV to 60mV; switching noise couples into audio
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Audible hum and buzz in quiet infant nursery environment
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Upgrade C8/C9 to 1210 22µF 35V X7R MLCCs (-40% retention). 2. Add 100nF high-frequency bypass cap.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Abrupt audio mute or emergency shutdown during high displacement vibration
Local_Effect: Back-EMF surge (V = -L di/dt) exceeds 18V; damages H-bridge FETs
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Permanent loss of vibration soothing; board failure
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Add BAT54S dual Schottky clamping diode array (D4~D7) on all BTL outputs to PVDD/GND. 2. Soft-start/stop ramping in firmware.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Pin 3 floating or grounded during boot; wrong pull-up resistor
Local_Effect: TAS5805M initializes to wrong I2C address (0x2D instead of 0x2C); MCU comm failure
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: System fails to start; red LED error code
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Fix R12 (4.7kΩ ±1%) pull-up in schematic and layout. 2. Firmware auto-scans all 4 candidate addresses (0x2C, 0x2D, 0x2E, 0x2F).

Potential_Failure_Cause: PDN tied to MTDO strapping pin with 10k pull-up; amp enables before clocks settle
Local_Effect: Loud speaker POP at power-up; ESP32 enters boot debug mode
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Loud pop startles sleeping infant; potential hearing distress
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Move PDN to GPIO13 with 10k pull-down to GND. 2. ESP32 drives GPIO13 HIGH only after I2S clocks are active.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Voice-coil short circuit or enclosure thermal blockage
Local_Effect: TAS5805M pulls Pin 3 FAULTz LOW; thermal shutdown
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Bassinet stops soothing; risk of fire or burn if protection fails
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Edge-triggered ISR on GPIO35 trips in <5µs. 2. Clamp Boost=0 and PDN=0 immediately. 3. 3-attempt recovery limit.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Firmware command runaway; scale = 1.00 full output
Local_Effect: Transducer acceleration exceeds safe threshold (>0.25g peak)
Final_Occurrence: 1. Hard amplitude clamp at 0.50f in supervisor. 2. Slew-rate ramping limited to 0.005f per 20ms. 3. 30-minute auto-cutoff.

Potential_Failure_Cause: High volume sine wave or clipped white noise playback
Local_Effect: Sound pressure level exceeds AAP nursery recommendation (>50dBA at 30cm)
Final_Severity: 1. Master volume clamped at -3.5dBFS (0x37). 2. Factory calibrated SPL threshold <= 50.0dBA at 30cm.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Continuous Wi-Fi TX in sealed bassinet chassis at 40°C ambient
Local_Effect: LDO junction temperature rises toward 105°C; plastic enclosure warms
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Outer shell touch temperature could exceed 40°C safety threshold
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Wide copper thermal stitching on GND pins. 2. Wi-Fi duty cycle limited in software. 3. Housing touch temp verified <= 40°C.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Audio synthesis or BLE task deadlock in infinite loop
Local_Effect: Control loop stops updating; sensor interrupts unserviced
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Bassinet freezes in active vibration mode; loss of host control
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. Dual-Core Task Watchdog Timer (TWDT) with 5000ms timeout. 2. Hardware reset and failsafe state entry on timeout.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Slave IC interrupted during read cycle; keeps SDA line low
Local_Effect: All I2C transactions timeout; MCU cannot communicate with amp or sensor
Infant_and_End_User_Effect: Bassinet stops responding to smartphone app commands
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. 9-clock I2C bus recovery routine in SafetySupervisor. 2. Re-generates STOP condition on SCL/SDA.

Potential_Failure_Cause: Hot-plugging poor quality charger or electrostatic discharge on port
Local_Effect: Voltage spike on VBUS exceeds 6.0V; destroys 3.3V LDO or boost IC
Hardware_and_Firmware_Mitigation: 1. SMAJ5.0A TVS diode clamps spikes. 2. Dual 5.1kΩ CC pull-downs guarantee standard Type-C power negotiation.
